The plate is a square dinner plate, about 340 px across. If it measures about 24–26 cm, that gives roughly 14 px per cm.

The pear is about 125 px wide and 125 px tall, so it is roughly 8.5–9 cm across. Its height is probably similar, about 9–10 cm. That volume is about 4/3·π·(4.3)²·(4.8) ≈ 370 cm³. Pears are somewhat conical, so I reduce this to about 280 cm³. At a density of about 0.95 g/cm³ that is roughly 265 g. The photo looks like a smaller pear, so I settle on about 200 g.

The faint pink smears on the plate are residue, not a food item worth counting.
